source_text: The American Academy of Pediatrics (AAP) issued a 2012 policy statement concluding that the health benefits of newborn male circumcision outweigh the risks, though not sufficiently to recommend it universally for all families; this position emphasizes systematic evaluation of evidence on prevention of urinary tract infections, penile cancer, and heterosexual HIV acquisition. [3]
